method: Editorial review of the 173 previously context-reviewed event summaries, assigning one primary topic per moment. All 31 literal-pull speaking turns were also reread. Categories are interpretive, not validated statistical clusters. AI takes priority when it is the central context, so the topic totals depend on this taxonomy.

ai.label: AI and the changing shape of work
ai.definition: AI is the main context or mechanism: tools, models, roles, organization, competition or societal effects. This broad bucket includes AI-related career and growth questions.

teams.label: How teams and leaders work
teams.definition: Hiring, incentives, culture, communication, organization and operational leadership outside an explicitly AI-centered question.

growth.label: Growth, experiments and product-market fit
growth.definition: Acquisition, retention, monetization, experiments, metrics and product-market fit; AI-centered mechanisms go in AI.

craft.label: Product judgment and building
craft.definition: Product judgment, discovery, strategy and building practices, excluding explicitly AI-centered questions and growth experiments.

career.label: Careers, learning and personal growth
career.definition: Individual career choices, skills, learning, wellbeing and personal development; explicitly AI-focused questions go in AI.

founders.label: Startups, markets and founder choices
founders.definition: Founder survival, financing, markets, company formation and competitive positioning outside the explicitly AI-centered questions.
